package com.acme.billing.validation;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;

import java.util.List;
import org.junit.Test;

public class ValidatorTest {

    @Test
    public void reportsEveryMissingField() {
        List<String> errors = new Validator().validate(new InvoiceDraft(null, null));
        assertEquals(List.of("customerId is required", "amount is required"), errors);
    }

    @Test
    public void acceptsCompleteDraft() {
        assertEquals(0, new Validator().validate(new InvoiceDraft("C-1", java.math.BigDecimal.TEN)).size());
    }
}
